STEP 3. Check the harness wire between column switch 
connector C-86 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111.
Q: Is the harness wire between column switch connector 
C-86 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to 4.
NO : Repair it. Check that the input signal from the 
windshield intermittent wiper interval adjusting knob 
can be checked and the wiper interval can be 
adjusted.
STEP 4. Replacement of ECU
(1) Replace the ETACS-ECU.
(2) Check that the input signal from the windshield intermittent 
wiper interval adjusting knob can be checked and the wiper 
interval can be adjusted.
Q: Is the input signal from the windshield intermittent 
wiper interval adjusting knob input normally?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Replace the column switch. Check that the input 
signal from the windshield intermittent wiper interval 
adjusting knob can be checked and the wiper interval 
can be adjusted.
